faq.q: Is it okay to feel sad?
faq.a: Yes, it is completely okay. Sadness is a normal feeling, and it shows you care about someone or something. It does not last forever.
asks: Should I hide that I am sad?

faq.q: Why do I cry when I am sad?
faq.a: Crying is your body's way of letting a big feeling out, and it shows others you need comfort. Many people feel a bit calmer after a good cry.
asks: Why do tears come when I am upset?

faq.q: How do I feel better when I am sad?
faq.a: Get a hug, talk to someone you trust, do something cosy like reading, or go outside for fresh air. Being kind to yourself helps too.
asks: How can I cheer myself up?

faq.a: Most sadness passes in hours or days. If you feel sad most days for two weeks or more, tell a trusted grown-up, a school counsellor or a doctor, so they can help.
asks: Why will my sadness not go away?

faq.q: What should I do when my friend is sad?
faq.a: Sit with them, listen, and ask if they want to talk or want a hug. You do not have to fix it; just being there helps a lot.
asks: How do I help a sad friend?

facts: Scientists have found that tears from crying contain more protein than the tears made when you chop onions.
Humans are the only animals known to cry tears because of feelings.
